            var mockMigrateSession = new Mock<MigrateSession>(loggerMock.Object, null!, null!, null!, null!, null!, null!)
            {
                CallBase = true
            };

                .Setup(m => m.CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync(It.IsAny<StoreType>(), It.IsAny<long>(), It.IsAny<long>(), It.IsAny<int>()))
                .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Act & Assert

namespace Garnet.cluster.tests
{
    public class MigrateSessionSlotsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync_Exception_LogsErrorWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>(); // Assuming interface exists or can be mocked
            var mockCts = new Mock<CancellationTokenSource>();
            
            // Create real instance with mocked dependencies if possible, or test the logging pattern
            // Since class is internal/sealed, test the specific logging extension behavior
            
            var testException = new InvalidOperationException("Test migration failure");
            loggerMock.Setup(x => x.LogError(
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}")),
                It.IsAny<object[]>()
            )).Verifiable();

            // Test the logging extension directly since the class is internal
            var logger = loggerMock.Object;
            
            // Simulate the exact LogError call from line ~210
            logger.LogError(
                testException, 
                "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}", 
                nameof(MigrateSession.CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync), 
                StoreType.Main, 
                100L, 
                200L, 
                4096);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == testException),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg == "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}"),
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 4 &&
                                          args[0].ToString() == nameof(MigrateSession.CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync) &&
                                          (StoreType)args[1] == StoreType.Main &&
                                          (long)args[2] == 100L &&
                                          (long)args[3] == 200L &&
                                          (int)args[4] == 4096),
                    It.IsAny<ExceptionDispatchInfo>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogErrorWithNullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger<MigrateSession>? logger = null;
            var testException = new InvalidOperationException("Test");
            var storeType = StoreType.Main;
            const long beginAddress = 100L;
            const long tailAddress = 200L;
            const int pageSize = 4096;

            // Act - null-conditional operator should prevent NRE
            logger?.LogError(
                testException,
                "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}",
                nameof(MigrateSession.CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync),
                storeType,
                beginAddress,
                tailAddress,
                pageSize);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(true); // No exception thrown
        }

        {
            // Arrange

                StoreType.Object,
                0L,
                1024L,
                8192);

            // Assert - verify through mock verification that correct overload was called
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Error),

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogErrorExtension_CalledWithMigrationParameters_LogsCorrectly()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var testException = new InvalidOperationException("Migration failed");
            var expectedMessage = "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogError(
                testException,
                expectedMessage,
                nameof(MigrateSession.CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync),
                (int)0, // StoreType.Main as int
                100L,
                200L,
                4096);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    testException,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogErrorExtension_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger? logger = null;
            var testException = new InvalidOperationException("Test");

            // Act & Assert - null-conditional prevents NRE
            logger?.LogError(
                testException,
                "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}",
                nameof(MigrateSession.CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync),
                0, // StoreType.Main
                100L,
                200L,
                4096);

            Assert.True(true);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogErrorExtension_ValidatesMessageTemplate()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var testException = new InvalidOperationException("Test");
            var messageTemplate = "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogError(
                testException,
                messageTemplate,
                "CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync",
                1, // StoreType.Object
                0L,
                1024L,
                8192);

            // Assert - called with Error level
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((object state, Exception? ex) => 
                        ex == testException && state.ToString()!.Contains("CreateAndRunMigrateTasks")),
                    testException,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
